doc.brief: The accessible role for a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible) implementation.
doc.md:
The accessible role for a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible) implementation.

Abstract roles are only used as part of the ontology; application
developers must not use abstract roles in their code.

alert.brief: An element with important, and usually time-sensitive, information
alert.md:
An element with important, and usually
  time-sensitive, information

alert_dialog.brief: A type of dialog that contains an alert message
alert_dialog.md:
A type of dialog that contains an
  alert message

application.brief: A toplevel element of a graphical user interface.
application.md:
A toplevel element of a graphical user interface.

This is the role that GTK uses by default for windows.

article.brief: A section of a page that consists of a composition that forms an independent part of a document, page, or site.
article.md:
A section of a page that consists of a composition that forms an independent
part of a document, page, or site.

block_quote.brief: A section of content that is quoted from another source.
block_quote.md: A section of content that is quoted from another source.

button.brief: An input element that allows for user-triggered actions when clicked or pressed
button.md:
An input element that allows for
  user-triggered actions when clicked or pressed

checkbox.brief: A checkable input element that has three possible values: `true`, `false`, or `mixed`
checkbox.md:
A checkable input element that has
  three possible values: `true`, `false`, or `mixed`

column_header.brief: A header in a columned list.
column_header.md: A header in a columned list.

combo_box.brief: An input that controls another element, such as a list or a grid, that can dynamically pop up to help the user set the value of the input
combo_box.md:
An input that controls another element,
  such as a list or a grid, that can dynamically pop up to help the user
  set the value of the input

comment.brief: A comment contains content expressing reaction to other content.
comment.md: A comment contains content expressing reaction to other content.

dialog.brief: A dialog is a window that is designed to interrupt the current processing of an application in order to prompt the user to enter information or require a response.
dialog.md:
A dialog is a window that is designed to interrupt
  the current processing of an application in order to prompt the user to enter
  information or require a response.

document.brief: Content that assistive technology users may want to browse in a reading mode.
document.md:
Content that assistive technology users may want to
  browse in a reading mode.

generic.brief: A nameless container that has no semantic meaning of its own.
generic.md:
A nameless container that has no semantic meaning
  of its own. This is the role that GTK uses by default for widgets.

grid_cell.brief: An item in a grid or tree grid.
grid_cell.md: An item in a grid or tree grid.

group.brief: An element that groups multiple related widgets.
group.md:
An element that groups multiple related widgets. GTK uses
  this role for various containers, like [`HeaderBar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.HeaderBar) or [`Notebook`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook).

label.brief: A visible name or caption for a user interface component.
label.md: A visible name or caption for a user interface component.

menu_item_checkbox.brief: A check item in a menu.
menu_item_checkbox.md: A check item in a menu.

menu_item_radio.brief: A radio item in a menu.
menu_item_radio.md: A radio item in a menu.

meter.brief: An element that represents a value within a known range.
meter.md: An element that represents a value within a known range.

none.brief: An element that is not represented to accessibility technologies.
none.md:
An element that is not represented to accessibility technologies.
  This role is synonymous to @GTK_ACCESSIBLE_ROLE_PRESENTATION.

presentation.brief: An element that is not represented to accessibility technologies.
presentation.md:
An element that is not represented to accessibility technologies.
  This role is synonymous to @GTK_ACCESSIBLE_ROLE_NONE.

progress_bar.brief: An element that displays the progress status for tasks that take a long time.
progress_bar.md:
An element that displays the progress
  status for tasks that take a long time.

radio.brief: A checkable input in a group of radio roles, only one of which can be checked at a time.
radio.md:
A checkable input in a group of radio roles,
  only one of which can be checked at a time.

row.brief: A row in a columned list.
row.md: A row in a columned list.

scrollbar.brief: A graphical object that controls the scrolling of content within a viewing area, regardless of whether the content is fully displayed within the viewing area.
scrollbar.md:
A graphical object that controls the scrolling
  of content within a viewing area, regardless of whether the content is fully
  displayed within the viewing area.

search_box.brief: A type of textbox intended for specifying search criteria.
search_box.md:
A type of textbox intended for specifying
  search criteria.

separator.brief: A divider that separates and distinguishes sections of content or groups of menuitems.
separator.md:
A divider that separates and distinguishes
  sections of content or groups of menuitems.

slider.brief: A user input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
slider.md:
A user input where the user selects a value
  from within a given range.

spin_button.brief: A form of range that expects the user to select from among discrete choices.
spin_button.md:
A form of range that expects the user to
  select from among discrete choices.

switch.brief: A type of checkbox that represents on/off values, as opposed to checked/unchecked values.
switch.md:
A type of checkbox that represents on/off values,
  as opposed to checked/unchecked values.

tab.brief: An item in a list of tab used for switching pages.
tab.md: An item in a list of tab used for switching pages.

tab_list.brief: A list of tabs for switching pages.
tab_list.md: A list of tabs for switching pages.

tab_panel.brief: A page in a notebook or stack.
tab_panel.md: A page in a notebook or stack.

text_box.brief: A type of input that allows free-form text as its value.
text_box.md:
A type of input that allows free-form text
  as its value.

toggle_button.brief: A type of push button which stays pressed until depressed by a second activation.
toggle_button.md:
A type of push button which stays pressed until depressed by a second
activation.

widget.brief: Abstract role for interactive components of a graphical user interface
widget.md:
Abstract role for interactive components of a
  graphical user interface
